items.title: Lifting a separable residue field into a complete local algebra
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if the residue field of a complete local algebra over a field is separable over that field, then the residue field embeds into the algebra as a section of the quotient map. The proof uses the characterisation of separable field extensions as formally smooth, upgrades that to formal smoothness for the adic topology on the residue field, and then applies the lifting result for continuous maps into complete local rings to obtain the required section.
